result.brief: CLAP 提出跨具身动作条件视频世界模型，用末端执行器位姿、语言指令与潜在动作统一异构动作空间，并通过课程学习先学物理先验再落地到真实任务，实现零样本物理仿真。
result.reason: Cross-embodiment action-conditioned video world model trained on internet-scale human and robot video, with latent action representations and curriculum learning; directly a general video world model contribution.
